scenes.name: THE RELEASE DECISION
lines: You can make a hundred cuts before lunch. Who decides which one goes on screen?
午饭前能剪出一百个版本。谁来决定播哪一个？
ChronoAI Pte. Ltd. built this launch around four bilingual books and six films. One flagship. Five shorts.
ChronoAI Pte. Ltd. 为发布会制作了四部双语书、一部长片和五部短片。

scenes.name: THE CHASSIS
lines: Anyone can rent an engine. Nobody trusts a bare engine on wet concrete. Where are the brakes?
谁都租得到发动机。把它放在湿滑的水泥地上，刹车在哪儿？
So we built the complete vehicle. NyxID holds the keys. Ornn governs skills.
我们造了整车。NyxID 保管密钥，Ornn 管理技能。
CMA and heca run agents. chrono-harness enforces executable judges.
CMA 和 heca 运行智能体，chrono-harness 执行判定规则。

scenes.name: WHAT A THEOREM ADDS
lines: Take a claim off the board. Can you recover it from the others? Then it makes no new distinction.
从黑板上擦掉一个命题。如果能由其余命题恢复它，擦掉前后就能区分同样的状态。
The independent research institute, The Omega Institute, froze 223,231 Lean 4 theorems in the November 27 snapshot.
The Omega Institute 的 11 月 27 日快照有 223,231 条冻结 Lean 4 定理。

scenes.name: TAKE A SEAT
lines: In Street Corner, four stands of eight rows hold 1,108 seats. Eighteen basket mats line the map wall.
街角会场的四面看台各有八排，共 1,108 席。世界地图墙边设有 18 块花篮垫。
Nine AI employee roles cover 102 of 120 workflows. On December 17, take a seat and check the evidence yourself.
九个 AI 员工岗位覆盖 120 项流程中的 102 项。12 月 17 日，请入座，亲手核验。
